decision.reason: The one-use official Polymarket US llms.txt capture passed its exact source gate and retained a complete 350-line source index with 342 link rows and 300 unique absolute HTTP URLs. Offline title-description deduplication found five economic families not represented in the registry. The frozen selection rule advanced only the first potential direct-cash family, Referral Incentive, under its own one-use contract and deferred every other linked source.
decision.why_not_an_edge: An index title, description, URL, access label, or endpoint name does not prove an economic contract, account eligibility, executable value, persistence, or profit.
decision.why_stop_after_one_linked_source: The source contract prospectively capped this index campaign at one exact previously unrepresented economic source, preventing outcome-aware page hopping after the first result.

prohibited_shortcuts: opening another linked economic page in this one-source index campaign
using titles descriptions access labels or endpoint examples as economic inputs
adaptive page selection after observing referral terms
requesting prices books fees accounts credentials applications referrals orders deposits funds or transactions
retry_trigger: Do not repeat the current index while its retained SHA-256 remains 308b0a29cf69d8b50fd9f5c841a21b51cebb5842d988fe4d53f77322fd980d60. Advance deferred families independently in rank order under fresh prospective source contracts; reopen this index only after an independently known material hash or documentation-architecture change.
